title: Input movement action
statement: For a machine with $k$ work tapes, a symbol alphabet, and a state set, given an input-head movement $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$ and a state $q$, the corresponding action attempts movement $d$ on the input head, leaves every work tape unchanged, emits no output, and continues in state $q$.
